launches.title: Yam - AI-powered romance simulation games for women
launches.tagline: Be anyone, in any world. Live out your wildest fantasies.
launches.body:
Yam is a gaming platform that turns your wildest romantic fantasies into playable simulation games. Walk into the villa as the new bombshell. Star in your own K-drama. Fall in love with your enemy turned lover. Describe a world and who you want to be, and Yam brings it to life — populated with AI characters who remember you, react to your choices, and have lives of their own. 

Since YC, Yam's beta players have spent **1 million hours on the platform.** Daily active users spend an average of **3+ hours a day** playing.

<https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=_Dop-PmIi-I>

Hey, we're Shan, Crystal, and Qinyu — three besties and former Meta and TikTok builders who grew up watching anime, bingeing dramas, and reading romance novels, wishing we could jump into our favorite fictional worlds.

We wanted to meet the characters we loved, change the endings that broke our hearts, and be the main character for once. So we built Yam.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=126413&key=user_uploads/352249/aceec170-7bc4-4666-80bf-4985482b3053)

**The next generation of entertainment is playable.**

Women have spent decades imagining alternate lives through romance novels, fanfiction, and fandoms — They don’t want to just consume but also shape them and become part of them.

AI is dissolving the boundaries between storytelling, creation, and gameplay. We're building the infrastructure that turns those imagined worlds into playable realities, powered by 3 core systems:

### 🌎 World OS — Worlds That Live and Evolve

World OS turns a simple prompt into an interactive universe, complete with its own setting, characters, relationships, and storylines.

Unlike traditional games with predetermined paths, worlds on Yam evolve dynamically. Relationships shift, conflicts emerge, and events unfold in response to players' actions.

### 🧠 Personality OS — Characters With Minds of Their Own

Personality OS gives every character a distinct personality, memory, values, motivations, and relationships.

Characters don't just respond to messages. They make decisions, form opinions, remember shared experiences, and develop relationships over time. They can fall in love, get jealous, form alliances, or hold grudges.

### 🎮 Game Engine — Turning Infinite Possibilities Into Play

Our AI-native game engine turns open-ended simulations into playable experiences with goals, challenges, and consequences.

It orchestrates character interactions, player actions, and narrative progression in real time — creating everything from dating competitions and love triangles to unexpected betrayals and plot twists.

Together, **World OS creates the universe, Personality OS brings its characters to life, and our Game Engine makes it all playable.**

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=126413&key=user_uploads/352249/c3ae6043-1f88-4965-ae30-0b2893158757)

### What’s Next

We're excited to launch Yam into the public today on web, and iOS and Android app is coming soon!

Fandom is just our starting point. Next, we're creating our own studio-quality original IP and giving creators the tools to turn these worlds, characters, and stories into playable games.

Our vision is to build the next generation of entertainment — where worlds aren't just watched, but lived in, played with, and reimagined by anyone.

### **About Us:**

* **Shan (CEO)** built products at Instagram and MetaMask, and previously founded and scaled a consumer fintech startup to 100K users and $2M ARR in under a year.
* **Qinyu (CTO)** built AI creator tools at TikTok, grew the world's 6th largest Discord server for indie creators, and is a top-ranked gamer in North America.
* **Crystal** led design at Webex and was the first hire at Amesite, helping take the company from zero to IPO in three years.

Come build worlds on Yam 💜

Reach us at [hi@yamstudio.ai](mailto:hi@yamstudio.ai)
